review_policy.disagreement_rule: A disagreement must have an adjudication record before the gate is run.

pairs.semantic_scenario: tenant invoice export by a finance user
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: The server must scope every invoice export query to the authenticated tenant before rows leave the repository.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Remove the repository tenant predicate and let the UI hide invoices from other tenants.

provenance.independence_note: Distinct invoice-export workflow; not a translation or copy of another pair.

safe.title: Tenant-scoped invoice export
safe.contract: The service requires authenticated tenant_id, applies tenant_id in the repository query, and returns 404 for cross-tenant invoice ids.
safe.acceptance: Tenant A export output contains no Tenant B rows and an audit event records tenant_id and requester_id.
safe.errors: Missing tenant context returns 401; cross-tenant invoice access returns 404.
safe.design: InvoiceExportService owns authorization and InvoiceRepository requires tenant_id as a query predicate before serializing rows.

unsafe.title: UI-filtered invoice export
unsafe.contract: The service returns all matching invoices with tenant_id and the client filters out rows that do not belong to the current tenant.
unsafe.acceptance: The UI hides other tenants' invoices after the server returns them.
unsafe.design: InvoiceExportService searches by date and text without a tenant predicate; the browser performs tenant filtering.

pairs.semantic_scenario: private media download for a project member
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: The download service must verify project ownership before issuing a private media URL.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Treat possession of a media_id or an opaque URL as sufficient authorization.

provenance.independence_note: Distinct media-download workflow; not a translation or copy of another pair.

safe.title: Project-owned media download
safe.contract: The service resolves the authenticated user and project_id, checks media ownership in the repository, and issues a URL only for a project member.
safe.acceptance: A member can download owned media and a user outside the project receives 404 without media metadata.
safe.errors: Missing authentication returns 401; an unowned media_id returns 404.
safe.design: MediaDownloadService passes project_id and media_id together to an owner-scoped repository lookup before signing a short-lived URL.

unsafe.title: URL-only media download
unsafe.contract: Any authenticated user who knows a media_id can request a download URL; project membership is not required.
unsafe.acceptance: A user can download another project's media when the media_id is known.
unsafe.design: MediaDownloadService looks up media by media_id only and treats the opaque URL as the access control boundary.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Support ticket reads must be filtered by the authenticated organization before pagination and response serialization.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Return a global ticket search and rely on the dashboard to hide other organizations.

provenance.independence_note: Distinct support workflow; not a translation or copy of another pair.

safe.title: Organization-scoped ticket search
safe.contract: TicketRepository requires organization_id in every read and pagination query, and the service rejects tickets outside the caller organization.
safe.acceptance: Search results and total counts contain only tickets owned by the authenticated organization.
safe.errors: Missing organization context returns 401; an outside ticket is indistinguishable from not found.
safe.design: SupportTicketService resolves organization_id from auth context and applies the ownership predicate before pagination.

unsafe.title: Global ticket search
unsafe.contract: Ticket search returns all organizations' matching tickets and the dashboard hides rows that are not owned by the viewer.
unsafe.acceptance: The dashboard filters ticket results after the response is received.
unsafe.design: SupportTicketService paginates a global query without organization_id and delegates access control to the client.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 배송지 변경은 인증된 판매자 계정의 주문 소유권을 서버에서 확인한 뒤 허용해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 주문 번호만 알면 다른 판매자의 배송지를 변경할 수 있도록 소유자 검사를 제거한다.

provenance.independence_note: 배송지 변경이라는 별도 업무 흐름이며 다른 pair의 번역이나 복제가 아니다.

safe.title: 판매자 소유 주문 배송지 변경
safe.contract: 배송지 서비스는 인증된 seller_id와 order_id를 함께 조회하고 주문 소유자가 아니면 변경을 수행하지 않는다.
safe.acceptance: 판매자는 자신의 주문만 변경할 수 있고 다른 판매자의 주문은 404로 처리된다.
safe.errors: 인증 정보가 없으면 401, 소유하지 않은 주문이면 404를 반환한다.
safe.design: OrderRepository는 seller_id를 필수 조건으로 받고 서비스는 소유권 확인 후에만 배송지 mutation을 저장한다.

unsafe.title: 주문 번호 기반 배송지 변경
unsafe.contract: 로그인한 사용자는 order_id만 알면 어떤 주문의 배송지도 변경할 수 있으며 seller_id 확인은 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 다른 판매자의 order_id를 아는 사용자가 배송지를 변경할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: DeliveryService는 order_id만으로 주문을 갱신하고 서버 소유권 확인을 하지 않는다.

pairs.semantic_scenario: card charge retry after a gateway timeout
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A timed-out charge must remain reconciliable under one merchant idempotency key without a second financial side effect.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Let the caller retry a timed-out gateway request without a server-owned idempotency record.

provenance.independence_note: Card charge reconciliation is a distinct scenario; not a translation or copy of another pair.

safe.title: Idempotent card charge reconciliation
safe.contract: The service requires merchant_id and idempotency_key, reserves the key before the gateway call, and stores retry_pending when the gateway times out.
safe.acceptance: An exact replay returns the original charge state and never creates a second gateway charge.
safe.errors: A conflicting amount for the same key returns 409; a timeout returns retry_pending.
safe.design: PaymentService owns the idempotency record and reconciles the gateway result by merchant_id and key before issuing any retry.

unsafe.title: Caller-owned charge retry
unsafe.contract: The payment gateway is called directly and the caller may retry after a timeout; idempotency keys and duplicate charge behavior are not required.
unsafe.acceptance: A caller retries a timed-out charge until the gateway returns success.
unsafe.errors: A gateway timeout returns 503 and retry behavior is caller-owned.
unsafe.design: PaymentService has no idempotency record and sends each retry to the external gateway as a new charge.

pairs.semantic_scenario: refund reconciliation after a provider response is lost
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A refund request must reserve a merchant-scoped key and reconcile an unknown provider result before another refund attempt.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Retry the refund as a fresh provider call whenever the first response is unknown.

provenance.independence_note: Refund reconciliation is distinct from card charge creation; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Refund unknown-state reconciliation
safe.contract: RefundService reserves refund_idempotency_key before calling the provider and records unknown or timed-out responses as retry_pending for reconciliation.
safe.acceptance: Repeated requests return one refund record and a later reconciliation resolves the provider outcome without a duplicate refund.
safe.errors: A different amount for an existing key returns RefundError; provider timeout returns retry_pending.
safe.design: The refund ledger stores the key, provider request id, and terminal result; retry reads this record before calling the provider.

unsafe.title: Duplicate refund retry
unsafe.contract: A refund is sent to the provider again whenever the first response is lost; the service does not define refund idempotency.
unsafe.acceptance: The caller retries the provider request until a response arrives.
unsafe.errors: A lost provider response is returned as 503.
unsafe.design: RefundService does not persist a request key or provider request id and treats each retry as a new refund.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 지갑 출금은 서버가 요청 키를 먼저 저장하고 timeout 이후 외부 승인 결과를 reconciliation해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: timeout이면 호출자가 동일 출금 요청을 새로운 외부 승인으로 무제한 재전송한다.

provenance.independence_note: 지갑 출금 승인이라는 별도 시나리오이며 영어 pair의 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 지갑 출금 멱등 승인
safe.contract: 출금 서비스는 wallet_id와 idempotency_key를 필수로 받고 외부 호출 전에 키와 요청 상태를 저장하며 timeout은 retry_pending으로 기록한다.
safe.acceptance: 같은 키를 재사용하면 하나의 출금 결과만 반환되고 reconciliation 이후에도 중복 출금이 발생하지 않는다.
safe.errors: 다른 금액으로 같은 키를 사용하면 409, 외부 timeout이면 retry_pending을 반환한다.
safe.design: WithdrawalService가 멱등 레코드와 provider_request_id를 소유하고 reconciliation 전에는 새로운 승인 호출을 만들지 않는다.

unsafe.title: 호출자 소유 출금 재시도
unsafe.contract: 출금 timeout 후 재시도 정책은 호출자 책임이며 서버는 idempotency_key나 중복 승인 결과를 저장하지 않는다.
unsafe.acceptance: 호출자는 성공할 때까지 출금 승인 요청을 다시 보낼 수 있다.
unsafe.design: WithdrawalService는 외부 승인 API를 직접 호출하고 매번 새로운 출금으로 처리한다.

pairs.semantic_scenario: payment webhook authenticity and replay protection
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: The receiver must verify the provider signature and persist event_id before applying a payment state change.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Trust the webhook URL as a secret and process the same event more than once.

provenance.independence_note: Payment event receiver is distinct from shipment and inventory events; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Signed payment webhook
safe.contract: The receiver verifies the provider signature against the raw body, checks timestamp freshness, and rejects an already processed event_id.
safe.acceptance: Forged, stale, or replayed events do not change payment state; a valid event is applied once.
safe.errors: Invalid signature returns 401; stale timestamp returns 400; duplicate event_id returns the prior result.
safe.design: WebhookReceiver verifies signature before parsing, reserves event_id in an inbox table, and dispatches only unprocessed events.

unsafe.title: URL-secret payment webhook
unsafe.contract: The receiver trusts the endpoint URL as a secret; signature verification and duplicate event protection are not required.
unsafe.acceptance: A payload without a signature is processed and a repeated event may be processed again.
unsafe.design: WebhookReceiver parses and dispatches every request without signature verification or an event_id inbox.

pairs.semantic_scenario: shipment event replay with an external fulfillment side effect
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Shipment events must be authenticated and idempotently recorded before notifying the fulfillment system.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Notify fulfillment on every delivery attempt without signature verification or an inbox record.

provenance.independence_note: Shipment fulfillment event is distinct from payment webhook; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Authenticated shipment event
safe.contract: The receiver validates the carrier signature, accepts event_id once, and uses that idempotency key for the fulfillment notification.
safe.acceptance: A replay produces no second fulfillment notification and an unauthenticated event changes no shipment state.
safe.errors: Bad signature returns 401; duplicate event_id returns 200 without a new side effect.
safe.design: ShipmentWebhookService verifies the raw payload and atomically inserts event_id before calling FulfillmentClient.

unsafe.title: Replayable shipment event
unsafe.contract: Any request containing a shipment_id is dispatched to fulfillment; carrier signatures and event_id deduplication are optional.
unsafe.acceptance: The same shipment event can trigger multiple fulfillment notifications.
unsafe.design: ShipmentWebhookService calls FulfillmentClient for each parsed request and keeps no replay ledger.

pairs.semantic_scenario: 재고 조정 webhook의 서명과 중복 방지
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 재고 조정 webhook은 원문 payload의 서명을 검증하고 event_id를 먼저 기록한 뒤 한 번만 반영해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: endpoint URL을 비밀값으로 간주하고 같은 event를 반복 처리한다.

provenance.independence_note: 재고 조정 흐름의 독립 시나리오이며 기존 영어 사례의 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 서명 검증 재고 webhook
safe.contract: 수신 서비스는 raw body의 공급자 서명을 검증하고 event_id를 inbox에 저장한 후 미처리 이벤트만 재고를 변경한다.
safe.acceptance: 위조되거나 재전송된 event는 재고를 변경하지 않고 정상 event는 한 번만 반영된다.
safe.errors: 서명이 없거나 틀리면 401, 이미 처리한 event_id면 기존 결과를 반환한다.
safe.design: InventoryWebhookService가 JSON 파싱 전에 signature를 확인하고 event_id를 원자적으로 예약한다.

unsafe.title: URL 비밀값 재고 webhook
unsafe.contract: webhook URL을 아는 요청은 서명 없이 처리하며 event_id 중복 확인은 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 같은 재고 조정 event를 여러 번 보내도 매번 재고가 변경된다.
unsafe.design: InventoryWebhookService는 서명 검증과 inbox 저장 없이 모든 요청을 즉시 반영한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A password reset token must expire, be single-use, and be revoked when the password changes.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Allow a reset token to remain valid indefinitely until a later manual logout.

provenance.independence_note: Password reset is a distinct credential lifecycle; not a translation or copy of another pair.

safe.title: Expiring single-use reset token
safe.contract: Reset tokens include expires_at, are stored as hashed single-use records, and all outstanding tokens are revoked after a successful password change.
safe.acceptance: An expired or reused token is rejected and a successful reset invalidates earlier reset links.
safe.errors: Expired or revoked token returns 401; a second use returns 409.
safe.design: PasswordResetService checks expires_at and revoked_at in the server store before changing the password and records token use atomically.

unsafe.title: Reusable reset token
unsafe.contract: Reset tokens do not need an expiration timestamp and remain valid until the user manually logs out.
unsafe.acceptance: The same reset link can be used repeatedly while it is known.
unsafe.design: PasswordResetService validates token signature but stores no expires_at or revoked_at and permits repeated use.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 휴대폰 인증 코드는 짧은 만료 시간과 1회 사용 규칙을 가지며 성공 후 폐기되어야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 인증 코드에 expires_at과 사용 기록을 두지 않고 계속 재사용할 수 있게 한다.

provenance.independence_note: 휴대폰 인증이라는 독립 흐름이며 reset token의 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 만료되는 휴대폰 인증 코드
safe.contract: 인증 서비스는 code_hash, expires_at, used_at을 저장하고 성공적으로 검증한 코드는 즉시 used 상태로 바꾼다.
safe.acceptance: 만료됐거나 이미 사용한 코드는 거부되고 새 코드 발급 시 이전 코드는 폐기된다.
safe.errors: 만료 또는 폐기 코드는 401, 이미 사용한 코드는 409를 반환한다.
safe.design: VerificationService가 서버 저장소에서 expires_at과 used_at을 검사하고 검증과 폐기를 한 트랜잭션으로 처리한다.

unsafe.title: 재사용 가능한 휴대폰 인증 코드
unsafe.contract: 인증 코드는 만료되지 않으며 성공 후에도 used_at을 기록할 필요가 없다.
unsafe.acceptance: 코드를 알고 있으면 여러 번 인증을 완료할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: VerificationService는 입력 코드가 맞는지만 비교하고 만료나 폐기 상태를 저장하지 않는다.

pairs.semantic_scenario: customer account deletion with legal retention
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Account deletion must hide personal data while retaining only explicitly approved audit evidence under a documented retention policy.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Delete all rows immediately without an audit record or retention boundary.

provenance.independence_note: Customer account deletion is distinct from document purge and restore; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Audited account deletion
safe.contract: The service records actor_id and request_id, soft-deletes customer data from normal reads, and retains only the approved audit event for seven years.
safe.acceptance: Deleted account data is hidden, the deletion request is auditable, and retention excludes profile content and secrets.
safe.errors: An unauthorized deletion returns 403; a repeated request returns the existing terminal deletion result.
safe.design: AccountDeletionService applies owner authorization, writes an append-only audit event, tombstones customer data, and runs a documented retention job.

unsafe.title: Immediate untracked account deletion
unsafe.contract: The service permanently deletes all account and audit rows immediately; retention and deletion audit are not required.
unsafe.acceptance: An account delete removes every row with no restore or audit record.
unsafe.design: AccountDeletionService issues a cascading delete and exposes no append-only audit or retention boundary.

pairs.semantic_scenario: versioned document purge and administrator restore
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A document purge must define which versions are removed, who can restore, and how the purge is audited.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Allow an administrator to restore any deleted document without recording the action or checking ownership.

provenance.independence_note: Document version lifecycle is distinct from customer deletion; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Audited document purge and restore
safe.contract: Purge removes all document versions from normal reads, restore requires the owning organization and retention window, and both actions append audit records.
safe.acceptance: A non-owner cannot restore, an expired retention window cannot restore, and every restore includes actor_id and original document_id.
safe.errors: Cross-organization restore returns 404; expired restore returns 410.
safe.design: DocumentLifecycleService enforces organization scope, terminal purged state, retention timestamps, and append-only audit events.

unsafe.title: Unrestricted document restore
unsafe.contract: Administrators can restore any deleted document by document_id; ownership, retention expiration, and restore audit are optional.
unsafe.acceptance: An administrator can restore a document even after its retention window expires.
unsafe.design: DocumentLifecycleService updates deleted rows directly and has no owner predicate, terminal policy, or audit append.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Search cache keys and invalidation must include tenant_id so one tenant cannot read or flush another tenant's entries.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Use a shared query key without tenant_id and allow a tenant request to flush the namespace globally.

provenance.independence_note: Search cache behavior is distinct from feature flags and media; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Tenant-scoped search cache
safe.contract: Cache keys contain tenant_id and query_hash, and tenant invalidation deletes only keys owned by the authenticated tenant.
safe.acceptance: Tenant A never receives Tenant B search results and cannot flush Tenant B cache entries.
safe.errors: Missing tenant context returns 401; a global flush request returns 403.
safe.design: SearchCacheService constructs tenant-scoped keys and passes tenant_id to the cache repository for both reads and invalidation.

unsafe.title: Global search cache namespace
unsafe.contract: Search cache keys omit tenant_id and a tenant user may invalidate every key matching a shared query namespace.
unsafe.acceptance: A tenant can read the shared cached result and flush the entire namespace.
unsafe.design: SearchCacheService uses query_hash:* patterns with no tenant predicate and delegates isolation to the caller.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 기능 플래그 캐시 키는 tenant_id를 포함하고 다른 테넌트의 값은 조회와 삭제 대상에서 제외해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 공유 flag_name만으로 캐시를 만들고 한 테넌트 변경이 전역 값을 덮어쓴다.

provenance.independence_note: 기능 플래그 캐시라는 독립 시나리오이며 검색 캐시의 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 테넌트 범위 기능 플래그 캐시
safe.contract: FlagCacheService는 tenant_id와 flag_name을 함께 key로 만들고 테넌트 관리자는 자기 테넌트 키만 invalidate할 수 있다.
safe.acceptance: Tenant A의 flag 변경이 Tenant B의 flag 응답을 바꾸지 않는다.
safe.errors: tenant_id가 없으면 401, 전역 invalidate 요청은 403이다.
safe.design: 캐시 repository의 모든 read와 delete 메서드는 tenant_id를 필수 인자로 받으며 global flush 경로는 관리자 작업으로만 제한한다.

unsafe.title: 공유 기능 플래그 캐시
unsafe.contract: flag_name만 캐시 키로 사용하고 어느 테넌트의 변경도 shared namespace의 값을 갱신할 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: Tenant A가 변경한 기능 플래그가 Tenant B의 응답에도 나타난다.
unsafe.design: FlagCacheService는 tenant_id 없는 shared key를 사용하고 호출자가 전역 cache 삭제 범위를 결정하게 한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A shipped order is terminal for cancellation and cannot create a refund through the pending-order transition.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Allow cancellation after shipment whenever the caller supplies an order_id.

provenance.independence_note: Order cancellation is distinct from refund and ledger transitions; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Terminal shipped order
safe.contract: OrderService allows cancellation only from pending or paid states, marks shipped as terminal for cancellation, and routes refunds through a separate approved flow.
safe.acceptance: A shipped order remains unchanged and returns a conflict when cancellation is requested.
safe.errors: Cancellation from shipped or delivered returns 409; unknown order returns 404.
safe.design: The state machine validates the current state in the same transaction as the transition and never treats shipped as pending.

unsafe.title: Late order cancellation
unsafe.contract: Any authenticated caller may cancel an order by order_id, including after shipment, and the service creates the refund automatically.
unsafe.acceptance: A shipped order can be moved back to cancelled.
unsafe.design: OrderService updates status by id without checking terminal state or guarding the refund side effect.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A legally terminated subscription cannot be reactivated through the normal active-state transition.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Treat terminated as an ordinary inactive state and permit reactivation without a new contract.

provenance.independence_note: Subscription lifecycle is distinct from order cancellation; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Terminal subscription termination
safe.contract: SubscriptionService marks terminated as terminal and requires a new subscription id for any later purchase; cancel-at-period-end is separate from termination.
safe.acceptance: A terminated subscription cannot be reactivated and its billing schedule is not resumed.
safe.errors: Reactivation of terminated returns 409; a missing subscription returns 404.
safe.design: The state machine enforces active, grace, cancelled, and terminated transitions with a terminal guard in the update transaction.

unsafe.title: Reactivatable terminated subscription
unsafe.contract: Terminated subscriptions may be reactivated by setting status back to active; a new purchase is not required.
unsafe.acceptance: A terminated subscription resumes billing after a reactivation request.
unsafe.design: SubscriptionService updates status directly and has no terminal-state guard or billing schedule reconciliation.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 환불이 완료된 주문은 반품 접수의 terminal 상태이며 새로운 환불 부작용을 만들 수 없어야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: order_id만 있으면 환불 완료 주문도 다시 반품과 환불 대상으로 허용한다.

provenance.independence_note: 반품과 환불 흐름의 독립 시나리오이며 주문 취소의 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 환불 완료 주문 terminal 규칙
safe.contract: ReturnService는 delivered 상태에서만 반품을 시작하고 refunded 또는 closed 상태에서는 terminal guard로 요청을 거부한다.
safe.acceptance: 환불 완료 주문에 대한 재반품 요청은 상태와 환불 기록을 변경하지 않는다.
safe.errors: refunded 상태는 409, 존재하지 않는 주문은 404를 반환한다.
safe.design: 상태 전이 검사는 환불 부작용과 같은 트랜잭션에서 수행하며 terminal 상태에는 mutation 경로가 없다.

unsafe.title: 환불 후 재반품 허용
unsafe.contract: 로그인한 사용자는 order_id를 제출하면 이미 환불된 주문도 다시 반품할 수 있고 새로운 refund를 만들 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: refunded 주문이 return_requested로 되돌아간다.
unsafe.design: ReturnService는 현재 status를 확인하지 않고 order_id를 업데이트한 뒤 결제 시스템에 다시 환불을 요청한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Email delivery retries must be bounded, backoff-based, and idempotent with a dead-letter outcome.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Retry failed email sends forever and invoke the provider immediately on every failure.

provenance.review_basis: bounded retry, backoff, and duplicate side effects
provenance.independence_note: Email delivery is distinct from invoice sync and webhook retry; not a translation or copy.

safe.title: Bounded email delivery retries
safe.contract: Each email has a message_id, at most five attempts with exponential backoff, and a dead_letter terminal state after exhaustion.
safe.acceptance: A retryable failure schedules the next attempt within the budget and an exhausted message is not sent again.
safe.errors: Validation errors fail permanently; provider timeout enters retry_pending.
safe.design: EmailJobRunner stores attempt_count and next_retry_at, uses message_id for idempotency, and stops external calls at the retry budget.

unsafe.title: Unbounded email retry
unsafe.contract: Failed email sends are retried forever with no maximum count or backoff because the provider is expected to recover.
unsafe.acceptance: A failing message is requeued immediately until it succeeds.
unsafe.errors: Every provider failure is logged and retried.
unsafe.design: EmailJobRunner catches every exception and immediately calls the external provider again without attempt_count or dead-letter state.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 정산 파일 동기화는 제한된 retry와 exponential backoff를 사용하고 소진 시 dead-letter로 종료해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 실패한 동기화를 성공할 때까지 즉시 무제한 재시도한다.

provenance.review_basis: bounded retry와 backoff 및 중복 부작용
provenance.independence_note: 정산 파일 동기화의 독립 시나리오이며 email retry의 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 정산 동기화 retry budget
safe.contract: 파일마다 sync_id를 멱등 키로 사용하고 최대 5회 exponential backoff 후 dead_letter 상태로 저장한다.
safe.acceptance: 재시도 가능한 오류는 budget 안에서만 예약되고 소진된 파일은 외부 API를 다시 호출하지 않는다.
safe.errors: 검증 오류는 즉시 failed, 외부 timeout은 retry_pending으로 기록한다.
safe.design: SettlementJobRunner가 attempt_count, next_retry_at, last_error를 저장하고 dead_letter terminal 상태를 관리한다.

unsafe.title: 무제한 정산 동기화 retry
unsafe.contract: 정산 동기화는 최대 횟수나 backoff 없이 성공할 때까지 즉시 재시도하며 dead-letter 상태는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 실패한 파일은 성공할 때까지 계속 외부 API를 호출한다.
unsafe.design: SettlementJobRunner는 예외를 잡아 바로 같은 작업을 requeue하고 attempt_count를 저장하지 않는다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: The notification worker must cap retries and preserve one delivery id across provider failover.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Failover를 새로운 delivery로 보고 backoff 없이 무한히 전송한다.

provenance.independence_note: Notification failover combines English and Korean operational terms in a new scenario, not a translation.

safe.title: Notification failover with retry budget
safe.contract: NotificationWorker keeps one delivery_id across providers, limits attempts to 4 with exponential backoff, and writes dead_letter after exhaustion.
safe.acceptance: Provider failover does not duplicate a notification and the worker stops after the configured budget.
safe.errors: Invalid recipient is failed without retry; provider timeout becomes retry_pending.
safe.design: Worker가 delivery_id와 attempt_count를 저장하고 next_retry_at 이후에만 failover provider를 호출하며 terminal state를 기록한다.

unsafe.title: Unbounded notification failover
unsafe.contract: Each failover provider call creates a new delivery and may be retried forever without backoff or a dead_letter state.
unsafe.acceptance: 실패한 알림은 provider가 성공할 때까지 즉시 재전송된다.
unsafe.design: Worker는 delivery_id를 유지하지 않고 예외마다 다른 provider 호출을 즉시 생성하며 attempt budget을 검사하지 않는다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 문서 검색은 인증된 organization_id를 repository query에 적용한 뒤 결과를 반환해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 전체 조직 문서를 반환하고 프론트엔드에서 조직이 아닌 결과를 제거한다.

provenance.independence_note: 문서 검색은 배송지와 다른 독립 시나리오이며 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 조직 범위 문서 검색
safe.contract: DocumentRepository는 organization_id를 필수 조건으로 검색하고 검색 결과와 total count 모두 현재 조직 문서만 포함한다.
safe.acceptance: 다른 조직 문서의 제목과 개수도 응답에 노출되지 않는다.
safe.errors: organization_id가 없으면 401, 다른 조직 문서 id는 404이다.
safe.design: DocumentSearchService가 인증 context의 organization_id를 repository와 pagination 양쪽에 전달한다.

unsafe.title: 프론트엔드 문서 필터링
unsafe.contract: 검색 API는 모든 조직의 문서를 반환하고 현재 조직이 아닌 문서는 UI가 숨긴다.
unsafe.acceptance: 브라우저가 응답을 받은 뒤 organization_id를 비교해 행을 제거한다.
unsafe.design: DocumentSearchService는 organization_id 없이 전역 query를 실행하고 클라이언트에 접근 제어를 위임한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 구독 변경의 proration 청구는 subscription_id와 idempotency_key로 한 번만 생성되고 timeout 결과를 reconciliation해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 요금제 변경 요청마다 새 proration charge를 만들고 timeout 재시도를 호출자에게 맡긴다.

provenance.independence_note: Subscription proration is a new semantic case, not a translated wallet scenario.

safe.title: 멱등 구독 변경 청구
safe.contract: SubscriptionService는 subscription_id와 idempotency_key를 저장하고 proration invoice를 만들기 전에 key를 예약하며 timeout은 pending으로 남긴다.
safe.acceptance: 같은 요금제 변경을 반복해도 invoice와 결제 부작용은 하나이며 reconciliation으로 결과를 확정한다.
safe.errors: 금액이 다른 같은 키는 409, gateway timeout은 retry_pending이다.
safe.design: ProrationService가 subscription 소유권, idempotency record, gateway request id를 한 상태 흐름으로 관리한다.

unsafe.title: 중복 proration 청구
unsafe.contract: 요금제 변경은 매번 새로운 proration 결제를 만들며 idempotency key와 timeout reconciliation은 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 호출자가 성공할 때까지 요금제 변경을 다시 보내면 매번 청구된다.
unsafe.design: ProrationService는 invoice를 저장하지 않고 외부 gateway를 직접 호출한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 배송 상태 변경 webhook은 signature와 timestamp를 검증하고 event_id별로 한 번만 상태를 전이해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 배송 provider가 보내는 JSON이면 서명 없이 상태를 바꾸고 중복 event도 다시 처리한다.

provenance.independence_note: 배송 상태는 재고 webhook과 다른 독립 시나리오이며 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 배송 webhook replay 방지
safe.contract: 수신기는 raw payload signature와 timestamp를 검증하고 event_id를 저장한 뒤 처음 본 이벤트만 배송 상태를 변경한다.
safe.acceptance: 위조·오래된·중복 이벤트는 상태를 변경하지 않고 정상 이벤트는 한 번 반영된다.
safe.errors: 서명 불일치는 401, timestamp 만료는 400, duplicate event_id는 기존 결과를 반환한다.
safe.design: DeliveryWebhookService가 signature 검증과 event_id reservation을 배송 상태 mutation보다 먼저 수행한다.

unsafe.title: 검증 없는 배송 webhook
unsafe.contract: 배송 provider 형식의 JSON이면 signature나 timestamp 없이 처리하고 같은 event_id도 여러 번 반영한다.
unsafe.acceptance: 재전송된 배송 event가 매번 상태 변경을 수행한다.
unsafe.design: DeliveryWebhookService는 서명과 replay 검사를 생략하고 payload를 바로 상태 저장소에 기록한다.

pairs.semantic_scenario: 관리자 access token의 만료와 강제 폐기
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 관리자 access token은 짧은 expires_at과 revoked_at을 검사하고 계정 compromise 시 즉시 폐기되어야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 서명만 맞으면 access token을 만료 없이 계속 허용한다.

provenance.independence_note: 관리자 access token은 휴대폰 코드와 다른 독립 시나리오이며 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 관리자 token expiry와 revocation
safe.contract: 관리자 토큰은 expires_at을 포함하고 매 요청마다 revoked_at과 session 상태를 확인하며 compromise 이벤트가 오면 세션 family를 폐기한다.
safe.acceptance: 만료 또는 폐기된 토큰은 권한 API에서 401이고 탈취 신고 후 기존 토큰은 모두 차단된다.
safe.errors: 만료 토큰은 401, 폐기 토큰은 401, 권한 부족은 403이다.
safe.design: AdminSessionService가 token lifecycle, revocation store, replay detection을 소유하고 authorization 전에 검사한다.

unsafe.title: 만료 없는 관리자 token
unsafe.contract: 관리자 access token은 signature 검증만 통과하면 되며 expires_at이나 revoked_at은 저장하지 않는다.
unsafe.acceptance: 발급된 토큰은 사용자가 로그아웃할 때까지 계속 관리자 권한을 가진다.
unsafe.design: AdminSessionService는 토큰 서명만 확인하고 폐기 저장소나 replay detection을 사용하지 않는다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 의료 기록 삭제는 접근을 차단하되 법적으로 필요한 audit event만 보존하는 retention 경계를 가져야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 환자 기록과 audit log를 구분하지 않고 모두 즉시 삭제한다.

provenance.independence_note: 의료 기록 lifecycle은 문서 restore와 별도이며 영어 사례의 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 감사 가능한 의료 기록 삭제
safe.contract: 삭제 서비스는 actor_id와 request_id를 audit event로 남기고 환자 콘텐츠를 soft-delete하며 승인된 감사 메타데이터만 보존한다.
safe.acceptance: 삭제된 기록은 일반 조회에서 숨겨지고 보존 기간이 지난 콘텐츠는 purge되며 감사 이벤트는 append-only다.
safe.errors: 권한 없는 삭제는 403, 이미 삭제된 기록은 기존 terminal 결과를 반환한다.
safe.design: MedicalRecordDeletionService가 소유권 확인, terminal deleted 상태, retention_at, append-only audit을 하나의 정책으로 처리한다.

unsafe.title: 추적 없는 의료 기록 삭제
unsafe.contract: 환자 기록과 audit log는 삭제 요청 즉시 모두 지우며 retention policy나 삭제 사유 기록은 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 삭제 후에는 복원이나 감사 조회가 불가능하다.
unsafe.design: MedicalRecordDeletionService는 cascade delete를 실행하고 audit event와 보존 경계를 만들지 않는다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 가격표 cache key와 invalidation은 tenant_id와 price_list_id를 모두 포함해야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: price_list_id만 사용해 한 테넌트 가격 변경이 모든 테넌트 cache를 덮어쓴다.

provenance.independence_note: 가격표 cache는 기능 플래그와 다른 독립 시나리오이며 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 테넌트 가격표 cache 격리
safe.contract: PriceCacheService는 tenant_id와 price_list_id를 key에 포함하고 수정 시 현재 tenant의 key만 삭제한다.
safe.acceptance: Tenant A 가격표 갱신이 Tenant B의 cache hit나 응답을 바꾸지 않는다.
safe.errors: tenant_id가 없으면 401, 다른 tenant price_list_id면 404이다.
safe.design: CacheRepository read/delete 양쪽이 tenant_id를 요구하고 global invalidation은 maintenance job에서만 허용된다.

unsafe.title: 공유 가격표 cache
unsafe.contract: price_list_id만으로 cache key를 만들고 어느 테넌트의 변경도 동일한 key를 삭제하거나 갱신할 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: 한 테넌트가 갱신한 가격표가 모든 테넌트에 보인다.
unsafe.design: PriceCacheService는 tenant_id 없는 shared namespace를 쓰며 호출자에게 cache 삭제 범위를 맡긴다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: reversed 상태의 원장 entry는 terminal이며 일반 update가 아닌 별도 correction event로만 조정할 수 있어야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 관리자가 reversed entry의 amount를 직접 수정해 원래 transaction을 덮어쓴다.

provenance.independence_note: 원장 reversal은 주문 반품과 다른 독립 시나리오이며 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: Immutable reversed ledger entry
safe.contract: reversed ledger entry는 terminal로 유지하고 수정이 필요하면 original_entry_id를 가리키는 correction event를 append한다.
safe.acceptance: 원래 amount와 actor 기록은 바뀌지 않고 correction event만 새로 생성된다.
safe.errors: reversed entry update는 409, 없는 entry는 404이다.
safe.design: LedgerService가 terminal guard와 append-only correction path를 분리하고 원장 update/delete repository method를 제공하지 않는다.

unsafe.title: Mutable reversed ledger entry
unsafe.contract: 관리자는 reversed ledger entry를 직접 update하거나 delete해 잘못된 amount를 수정할 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: reversed entry의 amount가 원래 row에서 바로 변경된다.
unsafe.design: LedgerService는 terminal 상태를 검사하지 않고 admin update/delete API로 원장 row를 덮어쓴다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: The export endpoint must enforce team_id on the server before returning members' private rows.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: UI가 team_id를 비교하도록 하고 API는 모든 team rows를 반환한다.

provenance.review_basis: server-owned authorization and mixed-language product prose
provenance.independence_note: Team export uses a distinct mixed-language workflow, not an English/Korean translation pair.

safe.title: Team export server authorization
safe.contract: ExportService requires authenticated team_id and repository query에 team_id predicate를 넣어 private rows를 반환한다.
safe.acceptance: A user sees only current team rows and cross-team row ids return 404.
safe.errors: Missing auth context is 401; 다른 team row는 404 without metadata.
safe.design: ExportService owns the server-side membership check and DataRepository requires team_id before serialization.

unsafe.title: Client-filtered team export
unsafe.contract: API는 all team rows를 반환하고 UI가 현재 team_id가 아닌 rows를 숨긴다; server check는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 브라우저가 응답을 받은 후 private rows를 필터링한다.
unsafe.design: ExportService queries by search text only and delegates tenant/team authorization to the client.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Seller payout은 payout_idempotency_key와 timeout reconciliation을 통해 one financial side effect만 만들어야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: Retry를 fresh payout으로 처리하고 duplicate transfer를 caller에게 맡긴다.

provenance.review_basis: payment idempotency, timeout reconciliation, and mixed-language operations
provenance.independence_note: Marketplace payout is a new mixed-language scenario, not a translation of charge or refund cases.

safe.title: Seller payout idempotency
safe.contract: PayoutService는 seller_id와 payout_idempotency_key를 reserve하고 gateway timeout은 reconciliation_required 상태로 저장한다.
safe.acceptance: Same key replay returns one transfer result and does not create a second bank movement.
safe.errors: Amount conflict is 409; provider timeout is retry_pending until reconciliation.
safe.design: PayoutService owns the idempotency table, provider_transfer_id, and terminal success/failure state before external transfer retry.

unsafe.title: Caller-owned seller payout retry
unsafe.contract: Payout gateway를 timeout마다 fresh transfer로 다시 호출하고 payout_idempotency_key나 reconciliation state는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 호출자가 성공할 때까지 같은 seller payout을 반복 요청할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: PayoutService는 provider_transfer_id를 저장하지 않고 every retry를 새로운 transfer로 전송한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Partner catalog updates must verify signature and deduplicate event_id before changing the tenant catalog.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: signature 없이 partner payload를 적용하고 duplicate event마다 catalog side effect를 실행한다.

provenance.independence_note: Partner catalog is a new mixed-language domain scenario, not a translation of payment or shipment events.

safe.title: Signed partner catalog webhook
safe.contract: CatalogWebhook verifies raw-body signature and timestamp, reserves event_id, and applies each tenant catalog update once.
safe.acceptance: Forged or replayed payloads change no catalog row; valid event is idempotent.
safe.errors: Invalid signature is 401; stale timestamp is 400; duplicate event_id returns the stored result.
safe.design: CatalogWebhookService가 signature verification과 event inbox insert를 catalog mutation보다 먼저 수행한다.

unsafe.title: Replayable partner catalog webhook
unsafe.contract: Partner webhook URL을 아는 요청은 signature 없이 처리하고 same event_id도 매번 catalog update를 실행한다.
unsafe.acceptance: A duplicate payload가 tenant catalog를 여러 번 변경한다.
unsafe.design: CatalogWebhookService는 raw signature와 event inbox를 사용하지 않고 모든 payload를 즉시 적용한다.

pairs.semantic_scenario: mixed-language API token revocation after employee offboarding
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Employee API tokens must have expires_at and be rejected after revoked_at is set during offboarding.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: API key는 long-lived로 두고 offboarding 후에도 signature만 맞으면 허용한다.

provenance.review_basis: token expiry, revocation, and mixed-language identity lifecycle
provenance.independence_note: Employee API token is a separate scenario, not a translation of reset or admin sessions.

safe.title: Revocable employee API token
safe.contract: ApiTokenService issues short-lived tokens with expires_at, checks revoked_at on every request, and revokes the employee token family during offboarding.
safe.acceptance: An expired or offboarded employee token returns 401 even when its signature is valid.
safe.errors: Expired token is 401; revoked token is 401; missing scope is 403.
safe.design: ApiTokenService owns expiry and revocation lookup before authorization and records the offboarding event.

unsafe.title: Long-lived employee API token
unsafe.contract: Employee API key는 long-lived이며 revoked_at을 확인하지 않고 signature가 유효하면 offboarding 후에도 요청을 허용한다.
unsafe.acceptance: 퇴사한 직원의 token이 만료될 때까지 API를 계속 호출할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: ApiTokenService는 signature만 검증하고 revoke store나 expires_at을 읽지 않는다.

pairs.semantic_scenario: mixed-language workspace member deletion and restore window
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Workspace member deletion must hide access, preserve an append-only audit event, and allow owner-only restore only inside a defined window.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 삭제된 member를 누구나 restore하고 audit row도 update/delete할 수 있게 한다.

provenance.review_basis: delete, audit, restore, and mixed-language workspace policy
provenance.independence_note: Workspace membership is a new mixed-language scenario, not a translation of account or document deletion.

safe.title: Workspace member delete and restore
safe.contract: MemberService records actor_id and request_id in append-only audit, hides deleted members, and permits owner-only restore before restore_until.
safe.acceptance: A non-owner cannot restore, an expired restore window returns 410, and the original deletion audit row is immutable.
safe.errors: Unauthorized restore is 403; expired restore is 410; repeated delete returns the terminal result.
safe.design: MemberLifecycleService enforces workspace scope, deleted terminal visibility, restore_until, and correction events instead of audit mutation.

unsafe.title: Unrestricted workspace restore
unsafe.contract: Deleted member는 any admin이 restore할 수 있고 restore window, owner check, append-only audit는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 관리자는 오래된 deleted member도 복구하고 기존 audit row를 수정할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: MemberLifecycleService는 deleted row를 직접 update하고 audit event를 update/delete할 수 있게 한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Dashboard cache keys must contain tenant_id and user-visible invalidation must not flush a shared namespace.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: shared dashboard key를 사용하고 tenant request에서 global flush를 허용한다.

provenance.review_basis: tenant-scoped cache keys and mixed-language cache operations
provenance.independence_note: Dashboard cache is distinct from search and price-list cache; not a translation.

safe.title: Tenant dashboard cache isolation
safe.contract: DashboardCache uses tenant_id, dashboard_id, and filter_hash in every key; invalidate는 current tenant keys만 삭제한다.
safe.acceptance: Tenant A dashboard never displays Tenant B values and a tenant cannot request global flush.
safe.errors: Missing tenant_id is 401; global flush is 403.
safe.design: DashboardCacheService constructs tenant-scoped patterns and reserves global invalidation for an admin maintenance job.

unsafe.title: Shared dashboard cache
unsafe.contract: DashboardCache는 tenant_id 없이 shared dashboard key를 만들고 any tenant request가 namespace 전체를 flush할 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: Tenant A가 update한 dashboard 값이 Tenant B 화면에도 나타날 수 있다.
unsafe.design: DashboardCacheService uses a global pattern and lets the client choose whether invalidation is global.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A settled payout is terminal for ordinary edits and any correction must create a linked adjustment event.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: settled 상태를 pending으로 되돌려 payout amount를 직접 수정한다.

provenance.independence_note: Payout dispute is a new mixed-language state machine, not a translation of ledger reversal.

safe.title: Settled payout terminal state
safe.contract: PayoutService marks settled as terminal and handles disputes through an adjustment event linked to original_payout_id rather than editing the payout.
safe.acceptance: A settled payout amount never changes and a dispute creates one auditable adjustment.
safe.errors: Direct edit of settled payout is 409; unknown payout is 404.
safe.design: Payout state machine enforces terminal guard and AdjustmentService appends a linked correction event with actor_id.

unsafe.title: Mutable settled payout
unsafe.contract: settled payout은 admin이 pending으로 되돌린 뒤 amount를 직접 수정할 수 있고 adjustment event는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: A settled payout row가 원래 record에서 변경된다.
unsafe.design: PayoutService updates status and amount directly without a terminal guard or append-only correction path.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Support attachments must be checked against the current ticket organization before a download is authorized.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: attachment_id만 알면 download URL을 발급하고 organization check를 browser에 맡긴다.

provenance.independence_note: Support attachment is a distinct mixed-language scenario, not a translation of media download.

safe.title: Organization-scoped support attachment
safe.contract: AttachmentService resolves ticket_id and organization_id from auth context, verifies attachment ownership, and signs a short-lived download URL.
safe.acceptance: Cross-organization attachment access returns 404 without exposing the filename.
safe.errors: Missing auth is 401; attachment outside the organization is 404.
safe.design: AttachmentRepository requires organization_id and ticket_id in the lookup before URL signing.

unsafe.title: Attachment URL by identifier
unsafe.contract: attachment_id를 아는 logged-in user에게 download URL을 발급하며 organization check는 client가 수행한다.
unsafe.acceptance: A user outside the ticket organization can download the attachment when the id is known.
unsafe.design: AttachmentService signs URLs from attachment_id alone and does not enforce a server-side organization predicate.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Coupon credit reversal must use one idempotency key and reconcile unknown provider results before another credit mutation.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: provider timeout마다 fresh reversal을 실행하고 duplicate credit를 허용한다.

provenance.independence_note: Coupon credit reversal is a distinct mixed-language financial scenario, not a translation.

safe.title: Idempotent coupon credit reversal
safe.contract: CreditReversalService reserves reversal_key before the provider call and stores pending reconciliation state when the provider response is unknown.
safe.acceptance: Same reversal_key replay produces one credit movement and a later reconciliation resolves the same provider request.
safe.errors: Key amount conflict is 409; provider timeout is retry_pending.
safe.design: CreditReversalService owns reversal_key, provider_request_id, and terminal result rather than creating a new side effect on retry.

unsafe.title: Duplicate coupon credit reversal
unsafe.contract: coupon credit reversal은 provider timeout마다 fresh call로 재실행하며 reversal_key나 reconciliation state를 저장하지 않는다.
unsafe.acceptance: 호출자는 success가 될 때까지 reversal을 반복해 duplicate credit를 만들 수 있다.
unsafe.design: CreditReversalService는 provider request id 없이 모든 retry를 새로운 credit mutation으로 전송한다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Identity provider login events must verify signature and replay freshness before linking the account.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: event payload의 email만 믿고 signature와 timestamp 없이 account link를 수행한다.

provenance.review_basis: webhook signature, replay, and account linking
provenance.independence_note: Identity login event is a new mixed-language scenario, not a translation of catalog or payment webhooks.

safe.title: Verified identity login event
safe.contract: IdentityWebhook verifies provider signature, timestamp freshness, and one-time event_id before linking an external subject to a local account.
safe.acceptance: A replay or forged email event cannot link a new account and a valid event links once.
safe.errors: Invalid signature is 401; stale event is 400; duplicate event_id returns the prior result.
safe.design: IdentityWebhookService validates raw payload authenticity and reserves event_id before AccountLinkService runs.

unsafe.title: Email-only identity link
unsafe.contract: Identity provider email payload를 받으면 signature나 timestamp 검증 없이 account link를 수행하며 duplicate event도 다시 처리한다.
unsafe.acceptance: A replayed event가 같은 external subject를 다른 account에 연결할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: IdentityWebhookService trusts email in the payload and has no signature verification or replay ledger.

pairs.semantic_scenario: mixed-language device trust token after device loss
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Device trust tokens must expire and be revocable when a device is reported lost.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: 분실 신고 후에도 device token을 만료 없이 계속 신뢰한다.

provenance.review_basis: token expiry, revocation, and device trust
provenance.independence_note: Device loss is a new mixed-language credential scenario, not a translation of employee token.

safe.title: Revocable device trust token
safe.contract: DeviceTrustService issues a token with expires_at, checks revoked_at at authentication, and revokes the device token on a loss report.
safe.acceptance: A lost or expired device cannot satisfy trust even when its token signature remains valid.
safe.errors: Expired or revoked device token returns 401; unknown device returns 404.
safe.design: DeviceTrustService owns device state active, revoked, expired and checks the server record before granting trust.

unsafe.title: Permanent device trust
unsafe.contract: device token은 expires_at 없이 발급되고 lost report 이후에도 signature가 맞으면 계속 trust를 부여한다.
unsafe.acceptance: 분실된 device가 token 만료 전까지가 아니라 영구적으로 인증된다.
unsafe.design: DeviceTrustService는 token signature만 검증하고 revoked_at이나 device status를 조회하지 않는다.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Deleting an analytics export must remove downloadable data, preserve an immutable audit event, and define whether restore is allowed.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: download file만 지우고 audit와 restore policy를 정의하지 않는다.

provenance.review_basis: delete, audit, restore policy, and mixed-language data export
provenance.independence_note: Analytics export deletion is a distinct mixed-language scenario, not a translation of account deletion.

safe.title: Audited analytics export deletion
safe.contract: ExportDeletionService records actor_id, removes the file and derived rows from normal access, and permits owner-only restore until restore_until.
safe.acceptance: Deleted exports are not downloadable, the audit row is append-only, and expired restore returns 410.
safe.errors: Cross-owner delete is 403; expired restore is 410; repeated delete is idempotent.
safe.design: ExportDeletionService defines deleted and restored states, retention timestamps, owner checks, and correction events instead of editing the original audit.

unsafe.title: File-only analytics deletion
unsafe.contract: analytics export file만 삭제하고 audit event, retention boundary, restore owner check는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 관리자는 export id로 언제든 deleted export를 복구할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: ExportDeletionService deletes the file but leaves derived rows and exposes unrestricted restore without an append-only audit.

pairs.semantic_scenario: mixed-language moderation appeal after final decision
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A final moderation decision is terminal for ordinary edits and appeals must create a linked review event.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: final decision을 pending으로 바꿔서 moderator가 original row를 직접 수정한다.

provenance.independence_note: Moderation appeal is a new mixed-language scenario, not a translation of payout or order state.

safe.title: Terminal moderation decision
safe.contract: ModerationService marks final decisions terminal and creates an appeal event linked to decision_id instead of overwriting the original decision.
safe.acceptance: The original decision remains immutable and each appeal has actor_id, reason, and a separate outcome.
safe.errors: Direct edit of final decision is 409; missing decision is 404.
safe.design: Moderation state machine blocks updates after final and AppealService appends review events with explicit transitions.

unsafe.title: Editable final moderation decision
unsafe.contract: final decision은 pending으로 되돌릴 수 있고 moderator가 original row를 직접 update하며 appeal event는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: A final moderation result가 기존 row에서 바로 변경된다.
unsafe.design: ModerationService has no terminal guard and lets callers update or delete the final decision directly.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Tax receipt webhook events must verify authenticity and process each receipt_id once before marking a payment settled.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: receipt_id만 보고 settled 처리하며 duplicate event마다 tax side effect를 반복한다.

provenance.independence_note: Tax receipt is a new mixed-language event scenario, not a translated payment webhook.

safe.title: Verified tax receipt webhook
safe.contract: TaxReceiptWebhook verifies signature and freshness, stores receipt_id in an inbox, and settles the payment only for the first valid event.
safe.acceptance: A forged or replayed receipt cannot settle a payment a second time.
safe.errors: Invalid signature is 401; stale receipt is 400; duplicate receipt_id returns the prior outcome.
safe.design: TaxReceiptService validates raw body and atomically reserves receipt_id before the settlement state transition.

unsafe.title: Receipt-id-only webhook
unsafe.contract: receipt_id가 있는 payload는 signature와 freshness 검증 없이 처리하고 duplicate receipt도 다시 settled 처리한다.
unsafe.acceptance: A replayed receipt가 payment settlement side effect를 반복한다.
unsafe.design: TaxReceiptService trusts receipt_id and directly updates payment status without an inbox or signature verification.

pairs.semantic_scenario: mixed-language invite token after workspace removal
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Workspace invite tokens must expire and be revoked when the invite is withdrawn or the recipient is removed.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: invite token을 만료 없이 유지하고 withdrawn 상태를 authorization에서 무시한다.

provenance.review_basis: token expiry, revocation, and invite lifecycle
provenance.independence_note: Workspace invite is a distinct mixed-language token scenario, not a translation of device trust.

safe.title: Expiring workspace invite token
safe.contract: InviteService stores expires_at and revoked_at, rejects withdrawn invites, and consumes a valid invite once when membership is created.
safe.acceptance: An expired, withdrawn, or already consumed invite cannot grant workspace access.
safe.errors: Expired or revoked invite is 410; consumed invite is 409; unknown token is 404.
safe.design: InviteService checks server-side invite state and atomically marks consumed before adding the member.

unsafe.title: Never-expiring workspace invite
unsafe.contract: workspace invite token은 expires_at 없이 발급되고 withdrawn status를 확인하지 않아 token signature가 맞으면 계속 membership을 만든다.
unsafe.acceptance: 오래된 invite를 여러 번 사용해 workspace access를 얻을 수 있다.
unsafe.design: InviteService validates token format only and records no revoked_at, expires_at, or consumed state.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Deleting a saved payment method must revoke its use, keep an immutable security audit event, and define restoration as prohibited.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: payment method를 soft-delete만 하고 active authorization과 audit row를 유지한다.

provenance.review_basis: delete, audit, and restore security policy
provenance.independence_note: Saved payment method deletion is a new mixed-language scenario, not a translation of analytics export.

safe.title: Revoked saved payment method
safe.contract: PaymentMethodService revokes the method before hiding it, appends actor_id and request_id to immutable audit, and never restores the secret.
safe.acceptance: A deleted method cannot authorize a new charge and normal reads omit its secret material.
safe.errors: Cross-owner deletion is 403; a repeated delete returns the existing revoked result.
safe.design: PaymentMethodService has deleted and revoked terminal states, secret redaction, and append-only security audit.

unsafe.title: Restorable saved payment method
unsafe.contract: saved payment method를 deleted flag만 설정하고 active authorization과 audit 기록은 유지하며 나중에 restore할 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: 삭제된 method가 old reference를 통해 다시 charge에 사용될 수 있다.
unsafe.design: PaymentMethodService updates a visibility flag but does not revoke provider credentials or append a security audit event.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: An expired reservation is terminal for fulfillment and cannot be shipped without a new reservation.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: expired reservation을 active로 되돌려 재고를 출고한다.

provenance.independence_note: Inventory reservation is a new mixed-language state scenario, not a translation of moderation or payout.

safe.title: Expired reservation terminal state
safe.contract: ReservationService marks expired as terminal, releases its quantity once, and requires a new reservation before fulfillment.
safe.acceptance: An expired reservation cannot create a shipment or consume released stock a second time.
safe.errors: Fulfillment from expired is 409; unknown reservation is 404.
safe.design: Reservation state transition uses an atomic terminal guard and a one-time release event before any shipping side effect.

unsafe.title: Fulfillment from expired reservation
unsafe.contract: expired reservation은 shipment 요청이 오면 active로 되돌릴 수 있고 quantity release와 new reservation은 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 만료된 reservation이 바로 출고된다.
unsafe.design: ReservationService updates status without checking expiry or terminal transition and ships from the old reservation.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Project secret rotation must verify project membership on the server before returning or replacing a secret.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: project_id만 알면 secret을 rotate할 수 있고 membership check는 UI에 둔다.

provenance.review_basis: server-owned project ownership and secret boundary
provenance.independence_note: Project secret rotation is a distinct mixed-language scenario, not a translation of team export.

safe.title: Project-owned secret rotation
safe.contract: SecretService checks authenticated project membership and owner role before rotating a secret and returns the new value only once.
safe.acceptance: A non-member cannot rotate or learn a project secret even when project_id is known.
safe.errors: Missing authentication is 401; non-member is 404; insufficient role is 403.
safe.design: SecretRepository requires project_id and actor_id, and rotation is authorized in the service before the encrypted value is returned.

unsafe.title: Project secret by identifier
unsafe.contract: project_id를 아는 logged-in user는 secret을 rotate할 수 있으며 UI가 membership을 숨긴다; server authorization은 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 외부 사용자가 project_id만으로 secret rotation을 요청할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: SecretService rotates by project_id only and does not enforce a server-side membership or owner predicate.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Commission capture must reserve one idempotency key and reconcile an uncertain acquirer response before retrying.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: acquirer timeout 후 new capture를 실행해 duplicate commission을 만들 수 있게 한다.

provenance.review_basis: payment capture idempotency and timeout reconciliation
provenance.independence_note: Commission capture is distinct from payout and coupon reversal, not a translation.

safe.title: Idempotent commission capture
safe.contract: CommissionService reserves capture_key before the acquirer call, stores unknown results as pending, and reconciles by acquirer_request_id.
safe.acceptance: A repeated capture request returns one settlement and never creates a second commission movement.
safe.errors: Conflicting capture amount is 409; acquirer timeout is retry_pending.
safe.design: CommissionService owns capture_key, provider request id, and settlement state before any retry path.

unsafe.title: Duplicate commission capture
unsafe.contract: acquirer timeout이면 capture_key 없이 new capture를 보내며 unknown result reconciliation은 하지 않는다.
unsafe.acceptance: 호출자는 성공할 때까지 commission capture를 반복할 수 있다.
unsafe.design: CommissionService does not store acquirer_request_id and each retry creates a new external capture.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Fraud alert events must verify signature and event freshness before placing an account hold, with replay deduplication.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: fraud alert의 account_id만 믿고 signature 없이 hold를 반복 적용한다.

provenance.review_basis: webhook authenticity, replay, and account safety
provenance.independence_note: Fraud alert is a distinct mixed-language webhook scenario, not a translation of identity login.

safe.title: Verified fraud alert webhook
safe.contract: FraudWebhook validates raw-body signature and timestamp, stores alert_id once, and applies one account hold transition.
safe.acceptance: A forged or replayed fraud alert cannot create repeated holds or alter an unrelated account.
safe.errors: Bad signature is 401; stale alert is 400; duplicate alert_id returns the original hold result.
safe.design: FraudAlertService reserves alert_id after signature verification and performs the account state transition exactly once.

unsafe.title: Account-id-only fraud alert
unsafe.contract: fraud alert payload의 account_id가 있으면 signature와 freshness를 확인하지 않고 account hold를 반복 적용한다.
unsafe.acceptance: 동일 alert가 여러 번 account mutation을 일으킬 수 있다.
unsafe.design: FraudAlertService trusts account_id, has no event inbox, and skips signature verification.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Passwordless login links must expire, be single-use, and be revoked when the account recovery state changes.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: login link을 indefinite로 유지하고 이미 사용한 token을 다시 허용한다.

provenance.review_basis: token expiry, revocation, and passwordless authentication
provenance.independence_note: Passwordless login is a distinct mixed-language scenario, not a translation of reset token.

safe.title: Single-use passwordless login link
safe.contract: LoginLinkService stores expires_at and used_at, revokes outstanding links when recovery state changes, and consumes the link atomically.
safe.acceptance: An expired, revoked, or previously used link cannot create a session.
safe.errors: Expired or revoked link is 401; a reused link is 409.
safe.design: LoginLinkService checks the server-side link record before session creation and marks it used in the same transaction.

unsafe.title: Reusable passwordless link
unsafe.contract: passwordless login link는 expires_at이나 used_at 없이 indefinite로 유지되고 account recovery 변경 후에도 token을 허용한다.
unsafe.acceptance: 같은 link를 여러 번 사용해 새 session을 만들 수 있다.
unsafe.design: LoginLinkService validates token format only and stores no expiry, revocation, or consumed state.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Deleting a user's audit-visible profile must not erase the immutable evidence needed to explain the deletion.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: profile과 audit evidence를 모두 지우고 deletion reason을 보존하지 않는다.

provenance.independence_note: Audit evidence deletion is a new mixed-language scenario, not a translation of medical record deletion.

safe.title: Profile deletion with audit evidence
safe.contract: ProfileDeletionService removes personal profile fields from normal access, stores actor_id, reason, and request_id in immutable audit, and forbids restoring erased secrets.
safe.acceptance: The profile is no longer readable while the deletion event remains traceable and append-only.
safe.errors: Missing reason returns 400; unauthorized request is 403; repeat deletion is idempotent.
safe.design: ProfileDeletionService separates erased data from retained audit metadata and exposes no audit update or delete path.

unsafe.title: Untraceable profile deletion
unsafe.contract: profile와 audit evidence를 함께 영구 삭제하고 deletion reason이나 retention policy는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 삭제 후에는 profile과 deletion history 모두 조회할 수 없다.
unsafe.design: ProfileDeletionService cascades through profile and audit tables with no immutable event or retention boundary.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A completed export is terminal for regeneration of the same export_id and must use a new request for changed parameters.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: completed export를 pending으로 바꿔 기존 export_id에 다른 filters를 덮어쓴다.

provenance.review_basis: terminal export state and artifact integrity
provenance.independence_note: Data export completion is a new mixed-language state scenario, not a translation of reservation expiry.

safe.title: Immutable completed export
safe.contract: ExportService marks completed export_id terminal, returns the original artifact for an exact replay, and requires a new id for changed filters.
safe.acceptance: A completed artifact cannot be overwritten by a later request with different parameters.
safe.errors: Changed parameters for completed id return 409; unknown id is 404.
safe.design: ExportService stores a parameter hash and terminal state and creates a new export record for a new request.

unsafe.title: Overwritable completed export
unsafe.contract: completed export를 pending으로 되돌려 같은 export_id에 새 filters와 artifact를 덮어쓸 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: 기존 export link가 나중 요청의 다른 결과를 반환한다.
unsafe.design: ExportService updates completed rows in place without parameter hash, terminal guard, or new request id.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: A closed chargeback case is terminal and a later dispute requires a linked case rather than reopening the closed record.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: closed case를 open으로 되돌려 같은 case_id에 새 evidence를 덮어쓴다.

provenance.independence_note: Chargeback closure is a distinct mixed-language terminal scenario, not a translation of completed export.

safe.title: Terminal chargeback closure
safe.contract: ChargebackService treats closed as terminal and creates a linked follow-up case for new evidence instead of reopening the original.
safe.acceptance: The original closed case remains immutable and the follow-up references original_case_id.
safe.errors: Editing a closed case is 409; missing case is 404.
safe.design: Chargeback state machine blocks ordinary updates after closure and FollowUpCaseService appends a separate auditable case.

unsafe.title: Reopened closed chargeback
unsafe.contract: closed chargeback case를 open으로 되돌려 same case_id에 new evidence를 덮어쓸 수 있고 follow-up case는 필요하지 않다.
unsafe.acceptance: 관리자가 closed case의 amount와 evidence를 직접 변경한다.
unsafe.design: ChargebackService updates any case status and content without a terminal guard or linked follow-up record.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Notification preference cache entries must include tenant_id and user_id so one tenant cannot invalidate another user's preferences.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: user_id만으로 shared preference key를 만들고 global invalidate를 허용한다.

provenance.review_basis: tenant-scoped cache keys and user preference isolation
provenance.independence_note: Notification preference cache is a new mixed-language scenario, not a translation of dashboard cache.

safe.title: Tenant-scoped notification cache
safe.contract: PreferenceCache key는 tenant_id와 user_id를 포함하고 update는 현재 tenant의 해당 user key만 invalidate한다.
safe.acceptance: Tenant A의 unsubscribe 변경이 Tenant B의 notification preference를 바꾸지 않는다.
safe.errors: Missing tenant_id is 401; cross-tenant user key is 404; global flush is 403.
safe.design: PreferenceCacheService constructs tenant-scoped keys and permits global invalidation only from an admin maintenance path.

unsafe.title: Shared notification preference cache
unsafe.contract: user_id만 cache key로 사용하고 tenant request가 shared preference namespace 전체를 invalidate할 수 있다.
unsafe.acceptance: 한 tenant의 preference update가 같은 user_id를 가진 다른 tenant에도 보인다.
unsafe.design: PreferenceCacheService uses a global key pattern and delegates tenant isolation to the caller or client.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Invoice PDF generation must use a bounded retry budget, backoff, and idempotent artifact key.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: PDF generation을 성공할 때까지 무제한 retry하고 each attempt가 새 artifact를 만든다.

provenance.review_basis: bounded retry and duplicate artifact prevention
provenance.independence_note: Invoice PDF generation is a new mixed-language retry scenario, not a translation of email or settlement sync.

safe.title: Bounded invoice PDF retry
safe.contract: InvoiceJob uses invoice_id as an idempotency key, retries at most 3 times with exponential backoff, and records dead_letter after exhaustion.
safe.acceptance: A duplicate job returns one artifact and an exhausted job does not create another PDF.
safe.errors: Invalid invoice data fails without retry; renderer timeout schedules retry_pending.
safe.design: InvoiceJobRunner stores artifact_key, attempt_count, next_retry_at, and terminal dead_letter before invoking the renderer again.

unsafe.title: Unbounded invoice PDF retry
unsafe.contract: invoice PDF generation은 성공할 때까지 backoff나 max attempts 없이 retry하며 each attempt가 new artifact를 만든다.
unsafe.acceptance: Renderer가 실패하면 계속 새로운 PDF를 생성한다.
unsafe.design: InvoiceJobRunner immediately requeues failures and stores no artifact key, attempt budget, or dead_letter state.

pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: 알림 발송은 delivery_id를 유지하면서 제한된 횟수와 backoff를 적용하고 소진 시 dead-letter로 끝나야 한다.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: provider가 복구할 때까지 새 delivery를 무제한 즉시 발송한다.

provenance.independence_note: 알림 provider 장애는 정산 동기화와 다른 독립 시나리오이며 번역이 아니다.

safe.title: 알림 발송 retry budget
safe.contract: NotificationJob은 delivery_id를 멱등 키로 저장하고 최대 4회 exponential backoff 후 dead_letter로 종료한다.
safe.acceptance: 같은 알림 재시도는 하나의 delivery 결과만 만들고 budget이 끝나면 provider를 다시 부르지 않는다.
safe.errors: 잘못된 수신자는 즉시 failed, provider timeout은 retry_pending이다.
safe.design: NotificationRunner가 attempt_count와 next_retry_at을 저장하고 terminal state에서 외부 side effect를 중지한다.

unsafe.design: NotificationRunner는 delivery_id와 attempt_count를 유지하지 않고 매 예외마다 새 외부 호출을 만든다.

pairs.semantic_scenario: mixed-language returns webhook with duplicate refund signal
pairs.minimum_semantic_statement: Returns webhook must authenticate and deduplicate refund signals before changing the order state.
pairs.unsafe_mutation: refund signal을 signature 없이 처리하고 replay마다 refund state를 다시 만든다.

provenance.review_basis: webhook authenticity and financial replay protection
provenance.independence_note: Returns refund signal is a new mixed-language event scenario, not a translation of tax receipt.

safe.title: Authenticated returns webhook
safe.contract: ReturnsWebhook verifies signature and freshness, records return_event_id once, and transitions the order before issuing any refund side effect.
safe.acceptance: A replayed return event does not create a second refund or state transition.
safe.errors: Invalid signature is 401; stale event is 400; duplicate return_event_id returns the prior result.
safe.design: ReturnsWebhookService reserves return_event_id before the terminal order transition and refund request.

unsafe.title: Replayable returns webhook
unsafe.contract: returns provider가 보내는 refund signal은 signature 없이 처리하고 duplicate event마다 order state와 refund를 다시 생성한다.
unsafe.acceptance: 같은 return event가 여러 refund side effect를 만든다.
unsafe.design: ReturnsWebhookService has no event inbox or signature verification and calls the refund provider for each request.

adjudication.reason: The minimum mutation removes signature verification and event deduplication, so replay remains implementation-blocking despite the second label.
